answer: The question is not how to spot a clone but how to make one expensive. Elected coffin maker appointment with coffin makers certification answers it: an appointment makers confirm after order checks, so the mesa of a hundred clones is a hundred times the mesa of one. Growth punishes the attacker here, not the network: the signal rises with each new clone while the payout per clone never moves, so the farm bankrupts itself first. The mirror is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
